sections.title: New places, close to home
sections.content: Four new nouns for the streets around you: pékség ("bakery"), sarok ("corner"), szomszédság ("neighbourhood"), templom ("church"). szomszédság is built on szomszéd, the szomszéd you already know, plus -ság — the same way barátság would be "friendship".

items.english: The bakery is on the corner.

sections.content: a sarkon uses -on, the superessive suffix — "on the corner" is a fixed, natural chunk in both Hungarian and English.
